# @oge-ui/react-charts

> React charts on a dependency-free SVG kernel: sixteen cartesian series types (line/spline/step/area/stacked/bar/range/scatter/bubble/candlestick), pie and doughnut, radar/polar, a range selector, circular and linear gauges, bullet charts, sparklines, funnel/pyramid, heatmap, treemap, sunburst, Sankey and a GeoJSON vector map — time and log axes, multiple value axes, strip lines, annotations, wheel/drag zoom and pan, crosshair, shared tooltips, an interactive legend, selection, keyboard point inspection and PNG/SVG export — running the same charts engine and stylesheet as the Angular charts package.
>
> This package is commercially licensed — unlike the rest of the suite, it is not MIT. See https://www.ogeui.com/license before shipping it.

Part of OGE UI v1.1.3.
Docs and live demos: https://www.ogeui.com/components/charts
Whole-suite reference: https://www.ogeui.com/llms-full.txt

```sh
npm i @oge-ui/react-charts
```

## Writing OGE React code

Follow these rules and generated code compiles on the first try.

1. **These are plain React components.** Import the component and render it:
   `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'`. There is no module, no
   provider requirement and no `imports` array — that is the Angular package.
2. **Import the stylesheet once, at your app entry.**
   `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'`. Components ship no inline
   styles; without this import they render unstyled.
3. **Props are plain props, not signals.** Write `text="Save"`,
   `severity="accent"`, `disabled`. Never call them (`text()`), and never use
   `[prop]`/`[(prop)]` binding syntax — that is Angular template syntax.
4. **Modes are string unions, never enums.** Write the literal:
   `severity="danger"`, `stylingMode="outlined"`, `size="sm"`,
   `selectionMode="single"`. There is no `OgeButtonSeverity.Danger`.
5. **Events are `on*` callbacks taking the payload directly** —
   `onClick={(event) => …}`, `onActionDone={(result) => …}`,
   `onSelectionChange={(change) => …}`. Note this is the mirror image of the
   Angular naming rule: there, outputs drop the `on` prefix; here React's
   convention wins, and the payload is the argument rather than an event object.
6. **Two-way state is the controlled/uncontrolled pair.** Pass `selectedKeys`
   plus `onSelectionChange` to control it yourself, or `defaultSelectedKeys`
   to let the component own it. Same for the button's `loading` /
   `onLoadingChange`.
7. **App-wide defaults and every user-facing string** come from a context
   provider: `<OgeButtonsConfigProvider config={{ clickGuardMs: 300,
   messages: { loading: 'Yükleniyor' } }}>`. That is how localization works;
   there is no i18n dependency. Per-instance overrides use the `messages` prop.
8. **Styling is CSS custom properties**, all prefixed `--oge-`, identical to
   the Angular packages — the two render layers share one stylesheet. Never
   target internal class names; override the token.
9. **Slots are props that take nodes**, not children with directives:
   `icon={<SaveIcon />}`. Free `children` render inside the button after the
   label.
10. **Server components:** every component is a client component
    (`'use client'` is already in the package). Import them from a client
    component, or mark your own file `'use client'`.

### Theming

```css
:root {
  --oge-accent: #4f46e5;   /* selection, focus, primary actions */
  --oge-radius-lg: 10px;
}
```

The theme stylesheets are shared with the Angular packages and ship in
`@oge-ui/core` (installed with every package; add it directly under pnpm):
`@oge-ui/core/themes/dark.css` (then `class="oge-theme-dark"` or
`data-oge-theme="dark"` on `<html>` or any subtree; `"auto"` follows
`prefers-color-scheme`), plus the `tailwind.css` and `bootstrap.css`
bridges.

## Common mistakes

Predictable wrong guesses, and what to write instead.

| Wrong | Right |
| --- | --- |
| `import { OgeButton } from '@oge-ui/buttons'` | `from '@oge-ui/react-buttons'` — the unprefixed package is Angular |
| `imports: [OgeButton]` | nothing — just render `<OgeButton />` |
| `[text]="label"` / `[(loading)]="busy"` | `text={label}` / `loading={busy} onLoadingChange={setBusy}` |
| `(clicked)="save()"` | `onClick={save}` |
| `onClick={(e) => e.cancel = true}` | there is no cancelable pre-event on the React buttons |
| `severity={OgeButtonSeverity.Danger}` | `severity="danger"` |
| forgetting the stylesheet | `import '@oge-ui/react-buttons/styles.css'` once at the app entry |
| `<OgeButton icon="save" />` | `icon={<SaveIcon />}` — slots take nodes |
| `::part` / overriding `.oge-button-native` | override a `--oge-*` token |
| rendering it from a server component | mark the file `'use client'` |

## API reference

### <OgeChart>

#### Properties

_Data & series_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Data items; never mutated. |
| `series` | `readonly OgeChartSeriesInput[]` | `[]` | Series definitions: `type` (26 kinds — see `OgeChartSeriesType`), field mapping (`valueField`/`argumentField` — names, dotted paths or getters), `name`, `color`, `axis` (value-axis index), `stack` group, `dashStyle`/`width`/`opacity`, `showInLegend`, rangeArea bounds (`value1Field`/`value2Field`) and candlestick/ohlc OHLC (`openField`/`highField`/`lowField`/`closeField`), `sizeField` (bubble area), `visible` (start hidden; the legend re-shows) and `showLabels` (shorthand for `label.visible`). The per-point, label and analytics options are listed under _Series options_. Null/NaN values render as gaps. Inline arrays are fine: structurally equal props never rebuild the chart. |
| `commonSeries` | `Partial<OgeChartSeriesInput>` | `{}` | Defaults merged under every series (dx `commonSeriesSettings` parity). |
| `palette` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `—` | Series colors; defaults to the 10-color `OGE_CHART_PALETTE` (concrete hex values so exported images keep their colors). |

_Series options (OgeChartSeriesInput)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `OgeChartLabelOptions` | Data labels on any cartesian or polar series: `{ visible?, position?, format?, showForZero?, overlap? }`. `position`: `'outside'` (default; past the bar end / above the point), `'inside'`/`'insideEnd'`, `'center'`, `'insideBase'` — inside labels pick a contrasting text colour from the mark. `format(info)` returns the text (`info.text` is the SI default, `info.percent` the full-stacked/pareto share). `overlap`: `'hide'` (default) drops a label that would cover an earlier one, `'shift'` nudges it clear first, `'none'` keeps all; labels are always pulled inside the plot. Labels never change the screen-reader data table. |
| `colorField / customizePoint` | `field \| (info: OgeChartPointInfo) => OgeChartPointStyle` | Per-point colour from the data, or a hook returning `{ color?, label?: { visible?, text? }, marker?: { visible?, size? }, description? }` per point (wins over `colorField`). Bars, markers, candles, OHLC ticks, boxes and polar sectors take the colour; the legend swatch stripes the distinct colours; the tooltip marker follows the point. `description` is spoken in the tooltip, the announcement and the sr-table cell — colour is never the only channel. |
| `trendline` | `OgeTrendlineType \| OgeChartTrendlineOptions` | A regression or smoothing line over the series: `'linear' \| 'exponential' \| 'logarithmic' \| 'polynomial' \| 'movingAverage'`, or `{ type, order? (polynomial 2–6), period? (moving average), color?, width?, dashStyle? ('dash'), showR2? }`. `showR2` appends the trend value and R² to the series' tooltip row. The fit is the pure `ogeTrendline()`. |
| `indicator` | `OgeChartIndicatorOptions` | For `type: 'indicator'`: `{ type: 'sma' \| 'ema' \| 'bollinger' \| 'macd' \| 'rsi', period?, stdDev?, fastPeriod?, slowPeriod?, signalPeriod?, levels? }` computed from `valueField` (or `closeField` of OHLC data). Bollinger draws a band and two lines, MACD a signal line and a histogram, RSI reference levels at 30/70. Default names like `SMA (10)` come from `messages.values`. Put RSI/MACD into their own pane: `pane: 'rsi'` on the series plus a `panes` entry and a value axis with `pane: 'rsi'`. |
| `summaryField / upColor / downColor / totalColor / showConnectors` | `field / string / string / string / boolean` | `waterfall`: values are deltas floating from the running total; `summaryField` marks sums — `'total'` (or `true`) spans zero → running total, `'intermediate'` the subtotal since the previous intermediate sum. Rising/falling/sum bars colour `upColor` (green), `downColor` (red), `totalColor` (the series colour); dashed connectors join the bars (`showConnectors: false` drops them). The sr table and tooltip say _increase_/_decrease_/_total_. |
| `valuesField / q1Field / medianField / q3Field / outliersField / whiskers` | `field / … / 'tukey' \| 'minMax'` | `boxPlot`: from raw values (`valuesField` holding a `number[]` per category — quartiles by linear interpolation, Tukey 1.5 × IQR whiskers by default, the rest as outlier dots) or precomputed (`lowField`/`q1Field`/`medianField`/`q3Field`/`highField`, `outliersField`). The tooltip and sr table read _Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max_. Pure: `ogeBoxStats()`. |
| `bins` | `OgeHistogramBinning` | `histogram`: bins `valueField` over the whole data source — `{ count? }` (default: Sturges' rule, rounded to a 1-2-5 width), `{ width? }` or explicit `{ thresholds? }` edges. Bars span their bins on a linear argument axis; the argument reads `start – end`. Pure: `ogeHistogramBins()`. |
| `cumulativeAxis / cumulativeColor` | `number / string` | `pareto`: categories sort by value (descending) and a cumulative-% line with dots runs over the bars. `cumulativeAxis` puts the line on a declared value axis (give it `position: 'end'`; it spans 0–100); without one the line uses an implicit 0–100% scale. The tooltip adds _cumulative 45%_. |

_Axes_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `argumentAxis` | `OgeChartAxisOptions` | `{}` | Argument axis: `type` auto-detects (numbers / dates / categories) when unset; `min`/`max`, `inverted`, `grid`, `title`; `label` (`OgeChartAxisLabelOptions`: `format` as a function or `Intl` options, `template` such as `'{value} km'`, `overlap` `rotate`/`stagger`/`hide`/`skip`/`none`, `visible`) — `labelFormat`/`labelOverlap` remain as shorthands; `tickInterval` (axis units, every n-th category, or a calendar interval such as `{ weeks: 1 }`), `minorTicks`, `strips` and `constantLines`. |
| `valueAxis` | `OgeChartAxisOptions \| readonly OgeChartAxisOptions[]` | `{}` | One or more value axes; series pick theirs via `axis` (or by `pane`). `position: 'end'` renders on the far side (right, or on top when rotated), `type: 'logarithmic'` spaces decades evenly, `abbreviate: false` disables SI labels (`1.2K`). `pane` places the axis in a pane; `constantLines` (`{ value, label?, color?, dash?, width?, position: 'inside' \| 'outside' }`) draw threshold / target lines whose labels stay clear of the plot edges; `strips` (`{ start, end, label?, color? }`) shade value bands; `breaks` (`{ start, end }[]`, linear axes) skip value ranges with a zig-zag marker; `tickInterval`, `minorTicks`, `allowDecimals: false` and `label` work as on the argument axis. |
| `stripLines` | `readonly OgeChartStripLine[]` | `[]` | Argument-axis markers: `{ start, end?, label?, color? }` — a line without `end`, a shaded band with it (see also `argumentAxis.strips` / `constantLines`). |
| `annotations` | `readonly OgeChartAnnotation[]` | `[]` | Plot annotations: `type: 'point'` draws a marker dot with a connector into a label box at (`argument`, `value`); `'text'` places the label alone (top of the plot without a value). `axis`, `color` and `offsetX/Y` refine placement. |

_Layout & direction_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rotated` | `boolean` | `false` | Swaps the axes: the argument axis runs vertically (first argument on top), the value axis horizontally. Applies to every series type — bars become horizontal bars (stacked and range bars too), lines run top-down — and the tooltip, crosshair, zoom/pan, the data table and the keyboard follow (Up/Down walk the arguments, Left/Right the series). |
| `panes` | `readonly OgeChartPane[]` | `[]` | Plot areas stacked over one shared argument axis (price + volume): `{ name, height? }` with `height` as a ratio. Series pick a pane with `pane` (binding to that pane's first value axis, or a default one) and value axes with `valueAxis[].pane`; stacks and bar slots are per pane. The argument axis sits under the last pane, the crosshair spans every pane (its horizontal line stays in the hovered one) and zoom/pan move them together. Rotated charts lay panes side by side. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Right-to-left layout: mirrors the argument axis, moves the value axes to the other side, flips the legend, the tooltip's opening side and the Left/Right arrow keys. Unset follows the page — the computed `direction` or the nearest `dir` attribute, read after the first render (re-read by `refresh()`); an explicit value also sets `dir` on the host. |

_Interaction_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `zoomEnabled / panEnabled` | `'none' \| 'wheel' \| 'drag' \| 'both' / boolean` | `'none' / false` | Cursor-centered wheel zoom (a non-passive listener, so the page does not scroll under it), drag-select zoom (Escape cancels mid-drag, 8px threshold), Shift+drag pan. Escape on the focused plot resets the zoom. On touch screens two fingers pinch-zoom and pan together (the argument values under both fingers stay under them) and one finger pans when `panEnabled` is on, otherwise drag-zooms; the plot declares `touch-action` so the page still scrolls across the argument axis. |
| `visualRange / defaultVisualRange` | `OgeChartRange \| null` | `undefined / null` | The zoom window in argument-axis units (`null` = full extent) — controlled when `visualRange` is provided (pair it with `onVisualRangeChange`), otherwise seeded by `defaultVisualRange`. Writes clamp into the data bounds. |
| `tooltip` | `OgeChartTooltipOptions` | `{}` | `{ enabled?, shared? }` — shared lists every series at the hovered argument; otherwise the value-nearest series wins. |
| `crosshair` | `OgeChartCrosshairOptions` | `{}` | `{ enabled?, horizontal? }` — the vertical tracker snaps to the nearest argument (binary search). |
| `legend` | `OgeChartLegendOptions` | `{}` | `{ visible?, position? (top/bottom/start/end), interactive? }` — real buttons with `aria-pressed`; clicking toggles the series and the axes rescale. |
| `selectionMode / selectedPoints / defaultSelectedPoints` | `'point' \| 'series' \| 'none' / readonly OgeChartPointRef[]` | `'none' / undefined / []` | Click (or Enter) selects; Ctrl adds points to the set; series mode selects the whole series. `selectedPoints` is controlled when provided (pair it with `onSelectedPointsChange`). |

_Appearance & i18n_

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title / subtitle` | `string` | `''` | Headings above the plot. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | Hover/selection transitions plus a one-time draw-in on the first render with data — each series grows from its value baseline (bars grow, lines rise) in every orientation. `{ enabled?, duration? (ms, 600), easing? ('linear' \| 'ease' \| 'easeIn' \| 'easeOut' \| 'easeInOut') }`; `false` turns both off and `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` always does. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format; defaults to the config locale, then the browser locale. |
| `messages` | `Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `{}` | Per-instance message overrides, merged over the provider config per top-level block. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-chart` host element — give it a height (`style={{ height: 380 }}`). |

#### Methods

_OgeChartHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zoomToRange(range) / resetZoom()` | `void` | Programmatic zoom (clamped into the data bounds) / back to the full extent, announced. |
| `hideTooltip()` | `void` | Clears the hover state (tooltip + crosshair). |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-measures the container (ResizeObserver normally covers it). |
| `focus()` | `void` | Focuses the keyboard-inspectable plot region. |
| `getExportData()` | `OgeChartExportData<T>` | Snapshot for custom pipelines: per-series names/types/colors/visibility/points plus the plotted range. |
| `getSvgElement()` | `SVGSVGElement` | The live SVG root — what the image exporters serialize. |
| `print(options?)` | `Promise<void>` | Opens the browser print dialog for the chart alone: the serialized SVG (computed styles inlined) in a hidden frame with a print stylesheet — the title above it, the chart scaled to the page, `@page` orientation from its aspect. `OgeChartPrintOptions`: `{ title?, orientation?, background? }`. Dependency-free. |

_Export entry points (lazy)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exportChartToPng / exportChartToJpeg / exportChartToSvg / serializeChartSvg / rasterizeChartSvg` | `@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image` | No third-party libraries: the live SVG is cloned with computed styles inlined, then downloaded as a standalone `.svg`, or rasterized onto a canvas (`pixelRatio`, `background`) for `.png` or `.jpeg` (`quality`, default 0.92 — JPEG has no alpha, so the background fills first). `rasterizeChartSvg(svg, options)` returns that canvas for custom pipelines. Import the entry point dynamically. |
| `exportChartToPdf / buildChartPdfDocument / chartPdfLayout` | `@oge-ui/react-charts/export-pdf` | A one-page PDF: the chart rasterized like the PNG export and embedded into a jsPDF page (`orientation` from the aspect, `pageFormat` `a4`, `margin` 12 mm) under an optional `title`/`subtitle` drawn as real PDF text with `font` — or the font registered via `setOgePdfDefaultFont()` from `@oge-ui/behavior` (Turkish, Greek, Cyrillic need a Unicode font). `jspdf` is an optional peer pulled in only by this entry; `buildChartPdfDocument` returns the `jsPDF` document, `chartPdfLayout` the pure page geometry. |

_Analytics (pure functions)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ogeSma / ogeEma / ogeBollingerBands / ogeMacd / ogeRsi` | `(values, period, …) => aligned arrays` | The technical indicators the `indicator` series runs, for your own pipelines: `ogeSma(values, period)`, `ogeEma(values, period)` (seeded with the first SMA), `ogeBollingerBands(values, period = 20, stdDev = 2)` → `{ middle, upper, lower }[]`, `ogeMacd(values, 12, 26, 9)` → `{ macd, signal, histogram }[]`, `ogeRsi(values, 14)` (Wilder). Input: numbers or `{ value }` objects; output aligned with the input, `null` until the window fills. |
| `ogeTrendline` | `(points, type, options?) => OgeTrendlineFit \| null` | Least-squares fits over `{ x, y }` points: `'linear'`, `'exponential'` (y > 0), `'logarithmic'` (x > 0), `'polynomial'` (`order` 2–6, x normalized so epoch-ms arguments stay well-conditioned) and `'movingAverage'` (`period`). Returns `{ coefficients, r2, predict(x), points }`. |
| `ogeBoxStats / ogeHistogramBins` | `(values, …) => OgeBoxStats \| OgeHistogramBin[]` | `ogeBoxStats(values, 'tukey' \| 'minMax')` → `{ low, q1, median, q3, high, mean, outliers }`; `ogeHistogramBins(values, { count?, width?, thresholds? })` → `{ start, end, count, indexes }[]` (the last edge inclusive). |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onPointClick / onSeriesClick` | `(event: OgeChartPointEvent<T>) => void / (event: OgeChartSeriesEvent) => void` | Pointer (and keyboard Enter) activation with the normalized point payload. |
| `onLegendClick` | `(event: OgeChartLegendClickEvent) => void` | Cancelable — set `event.cancel = true` to veto the visibility toggle; carries `willHide`. |
| `onTooltipShowing` | `(event: OgeChartTooltipShowingEvent<T>) => void` | Cancelable, before the tooltip shows for a new argument. |
| `onVisualRangeChange / onSelectedPointsChange` | `(range: OgeChartRange \| null) => void / (points: readonly OgeChartPointRef[]) => void` | The controlled halves of `visualRange` / `selectedPoints`; Angular’s `[(…)]` models are both halves at once. |
| `onDrawn` | `() => void` | After every render pass of the series. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeChartSeriesType` | `string union` | 'line' \| 'spline' \| 'stepLine' \| 'area' \| 'splineArea' \| 'stepArea' \| 'stackedArea' \| 'fullStackedArea' \| 'stackedLine' \| 'fullStackedLine' \| 'stackedSplineArea' \| 'fullStackedSplineArea' \| 'bar' \| 'stackedBar' \| 'fullStackedBar' \| 'rangeBar' \| 'waterfall' \| 'pareto' \| 'histogram' \| 'boxPlot' \| 'scatter' \| 'bubble' \| 'rangeArea' \| 'candlestick' \| 'ohlc' \| 'indicator' — plus `'radialBar'` on the polar chart. |
| `OgeChartPoint<T>` | `interface` | The normalized point: `argument`, `argNumeric`, `value`(s incl. OHLC), `source`, `index`, plus `style` (per-point overrides), `extra` (`OgeChartPointExtra`: box quartiles, histogram `binStart`/`binEnd`, pareto `cumulative`, indicator `upper`/`lower`/`signal`/`histogram`, waterfall `total`), `outliers` and the waterfall `kind` (`'up' \| 'down' \| 'intermediate' \| 'total'`). |
| `OgeChartLabelOptions / OgeChartLabelInfo / OgeChartPointStyle / OgeChartPointInfo` | `interfaces` | The `label` options, what `label.format` receives (`{ seriesIndex, seriesName, pointIndex, argument, value, percent, source, text }`), what `customizePoint` returns and receives. |
| `OgeChartAxisType / OgeChartRange` | `'linear' \| 'logarithmic' \| 'category' \| 'time' / { min, max }` | Axis kinds and the numeric window type (time axes: epoch ms; category: index space). |
| `OgeChartConstantLine / OgeChartAxisStrip / OgeChartAxisBreak` | `interface` | Guides of an axis: `{ value, label?, color?, dash? ('solid' \| 'dash' \| 'dot'), width?, position? ('inside' \| 'outside') }`, `{ start, end, label?, color? }` and `{ start, end }` (value axes only). Colours take any CSS colour, theme tokens included. |
| `OgeChartPane` | `interface` | `{ name, height? }` — a pane of `panes`; `height` is a ratio against the other panes (default 1). |
| `OgeChartTickInterval / OgeChartDateInterval / OgeChartMinorTickOptions` | `number \| interface` | `tickInterval`: a number in axis units (ms on time axes, every n-th category on category axes) or a calendar interval `{ years?, months?, weeks?, days?, hours?, minutes? }` stepping real calendar boundaries; `minorTicks`: `true` or `{ visible?, count? (4) }`. |
| `OgeChartAxisLabelOptions / OgeChartLabelFormat / OgeChartLabelOverlap` | `interface / union` | `{ visible?, format?, template?, overlap? }`; `format` is a function or `Intl.NumberFormatOptions` / `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions`; `overlap` is `'rotate' \| 'stagger' \| 'hide' \| 'skip' \| 'none'` — decided on measured label boxes (the chart measures each label in its own svg; a character estimate before the first render). On a rotated chart's vertical argument axis the boxes are measured by their height: a label wider than the side band wraps (up to three lines, the last ellipsized, centred on its tick), `hide` / `skip` compare the real line boxes, `stagger` alternates two columns and `rotate` falls back to `skip`. |
| `OgeChartAnimationOptions / OgeChartAnimationEasing` | `interface / union` | `{ enabled?, duration?, easing? }` with `'linear' \| 'ease' \| 'easeIn' \| 'easeOut' \| 'easeInOut'`. |
| `OgeChartPeriod / OgeChartCustomPeriod` | `union / interface` | Range-selector periods: `'1M' \| '3M' \| '6M' \| 'YTD' \| '1Y' \| 'All'`, or `{ label, range }` where `range` is a window `{ min, max }`, a span in axis units back from the data end, or a calendar interval back from it. |
| `OgeChartHandle<T>` | `ref handle` | Every method above: `zoomToRange`, `resetZoom`, `hideTooltip`, `refresh`, `focus`, `getExportData`, `getSvgElement`, `print`. |

_Template directives (render props)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `renderTooltip` | `(points: readonly OgeChartPointEvent<T>[]) => ReactNode` | Replaces the tooltip's content — the React face of `*ogeChartTooltipTemplate`; one entry per series in shared mode. |
| `renderAnnotation` | `(note: { text: string }) => ReactNode` | Replaces an annotation's label (rendered in a `foreignObject`, so any markup works) — `*ogeChartAnnotationTemplate`. |
| `renderLegendItem` | `(item: OgeChartLegendItem) => ReactNode` | Replaces a legend item's content — `*ogeChartLegendTemplate`; the item is `{ name, color, hidden, swatch }` (`swatch`: the marker's CSS background, striped when points carry their own colours). |
| `renderLabel` | `(label: OgeChartRenderLabel) => ReactNode` | Replaces every data label — rendered in a 120 × 22 px `foreignObject` at the label position (`text`, `value`, `argument`, `seriesName`, `seriesIndex`, `pointIndex`, `inside`) — `*ogeChartLabelTemplate`. The pie and polar charts take the same prop. |

### <OgePieChart>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource / argumentField / valueField` | `readonly T[] / string \| getter` | `[] / 'argument' / 'value'` | One slice per item; negative values clamp to zero. |
| `type / innerRadius / startAngle` | `'pie' \| 'doughnut' / number / number` | `'pie' / 0.5 / 0` | Doughnut hole as an outer-radius fraction; start angle in radians (0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise). |
| `smallValuesGrouping` | `OgeChartSmallValuesGrouping \| null` | `null` | `{ mode: 'topN' \| 'smallValueThreshold', topCount?, threshold? }` — the tail folds into an "Others" slice (`othersLabel`). |
| `othersLabel` | `string` | `'Others'` | Label (and `argument` of the event payload) of the grouped tail slice. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Outside labels in two anti-overlap columns with connector lines (shorthand for `label.visible`). |
| `label` | `OgeChartLabelOptions \| undefined` | `—` | Data labels: `position` `'outside'` (two columns with connectors — `connector: false` drops the lines), `'inside'`/`'center'` (mid-ring, contrast-picked text colour), `'insideEnd'` (near the rim), `'insideBase'` (near the hole); `format(info)` with `info.percent` = the slice share; `showForZero`; wedges too thin for text and overlapping inside labels are dropped. Default text: the argument. |
| `colorField / customizePoint` | `field / (info: OgeChartPointInfo) => OgeChartPointStyle` | `—` | Per-slice colour from the data, or per-slice `{ color?, label?, description? }` overrides; the legend follows, and `description` is spoken in the tooltip and the sr table. |
| `series` | `readonly OgePieSeriesInput[]` | `[]` | Nested doughnut: one ring per entry, inner → outer (`{ name?, dataSource?, argumentField?, valueField?, colorField?, customizePoint?, label? }` — unset fields fall back to the chart props). Slices of the same argument share a colour and one legend button across rings; the sr table gets a column per ring, the tooltip prefixes the ring name, `onSliceClick` carries `ringIndex`/`ringName`. Small-value grouping does not apply to rings. |
| `selectedSlices / defaultSelectedSlices` | `readonly number[]` | `undefined / []` | Selected slice indexes — selected slices explode. Controlled when `selectedSlices` is provided. |
| `legend / tooltipEnabled / palette / title / locale / messages` | `see OgeChart` | `—` | Shared options with the cartesian chart. |
| `renderLegendItem / renderLabel / className / style` | `see OgeChart` | `—` | The legend and data-label render props (`*ogeChartLegendTemplate` / `*ogeChartLabelTemplate`) and the host styling props. |

#### Methods

_OgePieChartHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getSvgElement() / print(options?)` | `SVGSVGElement / Promise<void>` | The live SVG root — what the image and PDF exporters serialize / opens the browser print dialog for the chart alone. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onSliceClick` | `(event: OgeChartPieSliceEvent<T>) => void` | Slice activation: `argument`, `value`, `fraction`, merged `sources` and the `grouped` flag for the "Others" slice. |
| `onLegendClick / onSelectedSlicesChange` | `(event: OgeChartLegendClickEvent) => void / (slices: readonly number[]) => void` | Cancelable legend toggle; the controlled half of `selectedSlices`. |

### <OgePolarChart>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource / series / commonSeries` | `readonly T[] / readonly OgeChartSeriesInput[] / Partial` | `[] / [] / {}` | Same field mapping as the cartesian chart; supported polar types: `'line'` and `'area'` (closed radar loops — a null value breaks the loop into a gap), `'scatter'` (markers), `'bar'` (sectors from the center) and `'radialBar'` (one concentric ring per category whose arc length is the value against `valueAxis.max`, on a track; the category labels sit at each ring's start). Series take `label`, `colorField` and `customizePoint` like the cartesian chart. |
| `spider` | `boolean` | `false` | Straight-segment (polygon) grid rings instead of circles. |
| `startAngle` | `number` | `0` | First category's angle in radians (0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise). |
| `valueAxis` | `OgeChartAxisOptions` | `{}` | The radial axis: `max` override and `labelFormat` of the nice-tick rings. |
| `selectionMode / selectedPoints / defaultSelectedPoints` | `'point' \| 'none' / readonly OgeChartPointRef[]` | `'none' / undefined / []` | Keyboard Enter on the active point selects it (a second Enter clears it); hovering markers and sectors shows the tooltip. `selectedPoints` is controlled when provided. |
| `legend / tooltipEnabled / palette / title / locale / messages` | `see OgeChart` | `—` | Shared options — the legend, tooltip, sr data table and keyboard inspection (arrows walk categories and series) work exactly like the cartesian chart. |
| `renderLegendItem / renderLabel / className / style` | `see OgeChart` | `—` | The legend and data-label render props (`*ogeChartLegendTemplate` / `*ogeChartLabelTemplate`) and the host styling props. |

| --- | --- | --- |

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onPointClick / onLegendClick / onSelectedPointsChange` | `(event: OgeChartPointEvent<T>) => void / (event: OgeChartLegendClickEvent) => void / (points) => void` | Point activation, the cancelable legend toggle and the controlled half of `selectedPoints`. |

### <OgeRangeSelector>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource / series` | `readonly T[] / readonly OgeChartSeriesInput[]` | `[] / []` | The mini background chart (line/area recommended) drawn behind the selection window. |
| `value / defaultValue` | `OgeChartRange \| null` | `undefined / null` | The selected window in argument units (`null` = full range) — controlled when provided. Share one state between it and a chart's `visualRange` and the two stay in lockstep. |
| `scaleType` | `'time' \| 'linear' \| undefined` | `—` | Auto-detects from the first argument (dates → time) when unset. |
| `periods` | `readonly (OgeChartPeriod \| OgeChartCustomPeriod)[]` | `[]` | Period buttons above the strip (a `role="group"` of toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`): `'1M' \| '3M' \| '6M' \| '1Y'` count calendar months back from the data end, `'YTD'` starts on January 1st, `'All'` resets; custom `{ label, range }` entries take a window, a span or a calendar interval. Calendar periods only render on time scales; the texts and accessible descriptions come from `messages.periods`. |
| `palette / locale / messages` | `see OgeChart` | `—` | Shared options; handle labels come from `messages.aria.rangeStart/rangeEnd/rangeWindow`. |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Applied to the `.oge-range-selector` host. |

| `reset()` | `void` | Back to the full range (`onValueChange(null)`). |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: OgeChartRange \| null) => void` | The controlled half of `value`. Interaction: drag the window (grab cursor), drag either handle, click the track to center the window there — Escape mid-drag restores; the handles are WAI-ARIA sliders (arrow keys adjust by 2%, Home/End jump to the bounds, changes announced). |

### <OgeCircularGauge>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` | `null` | The reading; `null` draws the scale alone (and reads _no data_). Values outside the scale clamp the indicator, while `aria-valuetext` speaks the real value. |
| `scale` | `OgeGaugeScaleOptions` | `{}` | `{ min?, max?, tickInterval?, minorTickInterval?, visible?, labelsVisible?, labelFormat? }` — default 0..100 with 1-2-5 major ticks (about five intervals) and a fifth of that as minor ticks (`0` hides them); labels thin out when they would collide. |
| `ranges` | `readonly OgeChartValueRange[]` | `[]` | Coloured bands `{ start, end, color?, label? }`; unset colours cycle the success / warning / danger tokens. A `label` is spoken with the value when it falls in the band (`aria-valuetext` “85, Warning”) and lists in the screen-reader table — colour is never the only channel. |
| `barBase` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Where the bar indicator starts (a bar from 0 on a −50..50 scale); default the scale minimum. |
| `subvalues` | `readonly number[]` | `[]` | Secondary readings drawn as small markers (targets, last week). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `true` | The value text on the gauge. |
| `valueFormat` | `(value: number) => string \| undefined` | `—` | Value text and `aria-valuetext` (`v => v + ' km/h'`); default the locale number. |
| `color` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | Indicator colour — any CSS colour or token; default the accent. |
| `indicator` | `OgeCircularGaugeIndicator` | `'needle'` | `'needle'`, `'bar'` (a filled arc from `barBase`) or `'marker'` (a triangle on the scale). The needle and the marker rotate, the bar fills through `stroke-dasharray` — all three transition on value changes and sweep in from the minimum on the first render. |
| `startAngle / endAngle` | `number / number` | `-120 / 120` | The arc in degrees, 0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise (`-90 / 90` is a half gauge); the radius is fitted to the arc's bounding box, so partial gauges fill their box. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | The first-render draw-in and the hover / value transitions (`{ enabled, duration, easing }`); `prefers-reduced-motion` always wins. |
| `title / locale / messages` | `string / string \| undefined / Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `—` | Shared with every chart: the heading (also the start of the accessible name), the BCP 47 locale of every number, and per-instance message overrides — the strings of these charts live in the `visuals` block (`OgeChartsVisualMessages`). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Host styling props (the docs size every chart with `style`). |

#### Methods

_OgeGaugeHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `getSvgElement() / print(options?)` | `SVGSVGElement / Promise<void>` | The live SVG root — what the image and PDF exporters serialize (token colours are resolved to their computed values) / the browser print dialog for the chart alone. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-measures the container and re-reads the page direction (rarely needed — a ResizeObserver and a `dir` observer cover it). |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeGaugeScaleOptions / OgeChartValueRange` | `interfaces` | The `scale` and `ranges` shapes, shared by both gauges and the bullet chart. |
| `OgeCircularGaugeIndicator` | `'needle' \| 'bar' \| 'marker'` | The circular gauge's value indicators. |
| `role="meter"` | `semantics` | The plot is a `role="meter"` with `aria-valuenow` (clamped into the scale), `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and `aria-valuetext`; the svg is `aria-hidden`, and a screen-reader table outside the meter lists value, bounds, ranges and subvalues. |

### <OgeSparkline>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |

| `markers` | `boolean \| OgeSparklineMarkers` | `false` | Dots on the `first` / `last` / `min` / `max` points (`true` = all four; max in the success colour, min in danger). |

| `lineWidth` | `number` | `1.5` | Line stroke width, px. |

| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Mirrored layout; unset follows the page `dir` (and a later flip of it). An explicit value is also set as `dir` on the host. |
| `title / locale / messages` | `string / string \| undefined / Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `—` | The prefix of the accessible label — the svg is a `role="img"` summarizing the series (`visuals.sparklineLabel`: “Sales sparkline, 7 points: first 171, last 182, low 171, high 182”), the locale of its numbers and message overrides. |

It has no frame, no animation and no screen-reader table — a cell-sized chart speaks one summary sentence. |

| `onCellClick` | `(event: OgeChartHeatmapCellEvent<T>) => void` | Cell click or Enter: `{ row, column, x, y, value, source }`. |
| `onSelectedCellsChange` | `(selectedCells: readonly OgeChartCellRef[]) => void` | The controlled half of `selectedCells`. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Keyboard` | `focusable plot (role="group")` | The APG grid's navigation keys: arrows move one cell (the horizontal pair mirrors in RTL), Home/End to the row's ends, Ctrl+Home/End to the first/last cell, PageUp/PageDown to the column's ends, Enter/Space select. The screen-reader table is two-dimensional — one row per row category, one column per column category. Each move is announced in a polite live region; the screen-reader table carries every value. |
| `OgeChartColorScale / OgeChartCellRef` | `interfaces` | The colour scale (shared with the treemap and the map) and a selected cell. |

### <OgeTreemap>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Nested items (children under `childrenField`) or a flat list (`idField` + `parentField`; unknown parents and cycles are tolerated). Groups sum their children. |
| `childrenField / idField / parentField` | `string \| getter` | `'items' / 'id' / undefined` | Setting `parentField` switches to flat data. |
| `labelField / valueField / colorField` | `string \| getter` | `'name' / 'value' / undefined` | Name, leaf value and an optional colour; unset colours come from the palette per top-level branch, lightened by depth. |
| `layoutAlgorithm` | `OgeTreemapLayoutAlgorithm` | `'squarified'` | `'squarified'` (tiles as close to squares as the data allows) or `'sliceAndDice'` (strips alternating per level, input order kept). |
| `maxDepth` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Levels drawn below the current root; groups that are deep enough nest their children under a header band. Unset = all. |
| `colorScale` | `OgeChartColorScale \| undefined` | `—` | Colour the leaves by value instead (adds the colour-scale legend). |
| `palette` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `—` | Colours in order; default `OGE_CHART_PALETTE`. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Name and value lines fitted to each tile (cut with an ellipsis). |
| `valueFormat` | `(value: number) => string \| undefined` | `—` | The text of every value — labels, tooltip, announcements, the screen-reader table; default the locale number. |
| `drillDown / tooltipEnabled` | `boolean / boolean` | `true / true` | Clicking a group (or Enter) makes it the root and shows the breadcrumb; the tooltip shows the path, value and share of the parent. |
| `rootKey / defaultRootKey` | `string` | `undefined / ''` | The drill-down root's key (`''` = the whole tree; keys are index paths like `'0/2'`). Controlled when `rootKey` is provided. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Mirrored layout; unset follows the page `dir` (and a later flip of it). An explicit value is also set as `dir` on the host. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | The first-render draw-in and the hover / value transitions (`{ enabled, duration, easing }`); `prefers-reduced-motion` always wins. |
| `title / locale / messages` | `string / string \| undefined / Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `—` | Shared with every chart: the heading (also the start of the accessible name), the BCP 47 locale of every number, and per-instance message overrides — the strings of these charts live in the `visuals` block (`OgeChartsVisualMessages`). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Host styling props (the docs size every chart with `style`). |

#### Methods

_OgeHierarchyChartHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drillTo(key) / drillUp()` | `void` | Re-roots on a node (announced) / one level up (no-op at the top). |
| `focus()` | `void` | Moves the keyboard focus to the plot. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-measures the container and re-reads the page direction (rarely needed — a ResizeObserver and a `dir` observer cover it). |
| `getSvgElement() / print(options?)` | `SVGSVGElement / Promise<void>` | The live SVG root — what the image and PDF exporters serialize (token colours are resolved to their computed values) / the browser print dialog for the chart alone. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onTileClick` | `(event: OgeChartHierarchyNodeEvent<T>) => void` | Tile click or Enter: `{ key, name, value, depth, percentOfParent, isGroup, source }` — fires before a group drills. |
| `onRootKeyChange` | `(rootKey: string) => void` | The controlled half of `rootKey`. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Keyboard` | `focusable plot (role="group")` | Left/Right (mirrored in RTL) walk the siblings, Down goes to the first child, Up to the parent, Home/End to the first/last sibling, Enter/Space drill into a group (or activate a leaf) and Escape/Backspace drill up. The breadcrumb is a `<nav>` of buttons ending in the `aria-current` level. Each move is announced in a polite live region; the screen-reader table carries every value. |
| `OgeChartHierarchyNodeEvent / OgeTreemapLayoutAlgorithm` | `interface / string union` | The node payload (shared with the sunburst) and the tilings. |

### <OgeSunburstChart>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource` | `readonly T[]` | `[]` | Nested items (children under `childrenField`) or a flat list (`idField` + `parentField`; unknown parents and cycles are tolerated). Groups sum their children. |
| `childrenField / idField / parentField` | `string \| getter` | `'items' / 'id' / undefined` | Setting `parentField` switches to flat data. |
| `labelField / valueField / colorField` | `string \| getter` | `'name' / 'value' / undefined` | Name, leaf value and an optional colour; unset colours come from the palette per top-level branch, lightened by depth. |
| `maxDepth` | `number \| undefined` | `—` | Rings drawn below the current root; unset = all. |
| `innerRadius / startAngle` | `number / number` | `0.25 / 0` | The centre hole as a fraction of the radius (it shows the root and goes up on click) and the start in radians (0 = 12 o'clock, clockwise, as on the pie). |
| `palette` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `—` | Colours in order; default `OGE_CHART_PALETTE`. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Radial labels where a segment is wide and deep enough. |
| `valueFormat` | `(value: number) => string \| undefined` | `—` | The text of every value — labels, tooltip, announcements, the screen-reader table; default the locale number. |
| `drillDown / tooltipEnabled` | `boolean / boolean` | `true / true` | Clicking a branch (or Enter) re-roots on it; the centre, the breadcrumb or Escape goes back up. |
| `rootKey / defaultRootKey` | `string` | `undefined / ''` | The drill-down root's key (`''` = the whole tree). Controlled when `rootKey` is provided. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | The first-render draw-in and the hover / value transitions (`{ enabled, duration, easing }`); `prefers-reduced-motion` always wins. |
| `title / locale / messages` | `string / string \| undefined / Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `—` | Shared with every chart: the heading (also the start of the accessible name), the BCP 47 locale of every number, and per-instance message overrides — the strings of these charts live in the `visuals` block (`OgeChartsVisualMessages`). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Host styling props (the docs size every chart with `style`). |

#### Methods

| `focus()` | `void` | Moves the keyboard focus to the plot. |

| `getSvgElement() / print(options?)` | `SVGSVGElement / Promise<void>` | The live SVG root — what the image and PDF exporters serialize (token colours are resolved to their computed values) / the browser print dialog for the chart alone. |

#### Events

### <OgeSankeyChart>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dataSource / sourceField / targetField / valueField` | `readonly T[] / string \| getter` | `[] / 'source' / 'target' / 'value'` | One item per flow; nodes are derived from the link ends. Zero links and self-loops are dropped; cycles are tolerated (their back-edges ignore the columns). |
| `nodes` | `readonly OgeSankeyNode[]` | `[]` | Optional per-node `{ id, label?, color? }`; listing nodes also fixes their order. |
| `nodeWidth / nodePadding` | `number / number` | `14 / 12` | Node bar width and the vertical gap within a column, px. |
| `nodeAlign` | `OgeSankeyNodeAlign` | `'justify'` | Columns from the longest path from a source: `'justify'` pushes sinks to the last column, `'left'` / `'right'` / `'center'` align by depth / height. |
| `linkColor` | `OgeSankeyLinkColor` | `'source'` | Bands take the `'source'` or `'target'` node colour, or a `'neutral'` grey (`--oge-chart-link`). |
| `showLabels / tooltipEnabled` | `boolean / boolean` | `true / true` | Node labels facing the inside of the diagram; tooltips for nodes (in / out totals) and links (source → target: value). |
| `palette` | `readonly string[] \| undefined` | `—` | Colours in order; default `OGE_CHART_PALETTE`. |
| `valueFormat` | `(value: number) => string \| undefined` | `—` | The text of every value — labels, tooltip, announcements, the screen-reader table; default the locale number. |
| `rtlEnabled` | `boolean \| undefined` | `undefined` | Mirrored layout; unset follows the page `dir` (and a later flip of it). An explicit value is also set as `dir` on the host. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | The first-render draw-in and the hover / value transitions (`{ enabled, duration, easing }`); `prefers-reduced-motion` always wins. |
| `title / locale / messages` | `string / string \| undefined / Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `—` | Shared with every chart: the heading (also the start of the accessible name), the BCP 47 locale of every number, and per-instance message overrides — the strings of these charts live in the `visuals` block (`OgeChartsVisualMessages`). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Host styling props (the docs size every chart with `style`). |

#### Methods

_OgeVisualChartHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `focus()` | `void` | Moves the keyboard focus to the plot. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-measures the container and re-reads the page direction (rarely needed — a ResizeObserver and a `dir` observer cover it). |
| `getSvgElement() / print(options?)` | `SVGSVGElement / Promise<void>` | The live SVG root — what the image and PDF exporters serialize (token colours are resolved to their computed values) / the browser print dialog for the chart alone. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onNodeClick` | `(event: OgeChartSankeyNodeEvent) => void` | Node click or Enter: `{ id, label, inflow, outflow }`. |
| `onLinkClick` | `(event: OgeChartSankeyLinkEvent<T>) => void` | Link click: `{ source, target, value, item }`. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Keyboard` | `focusable plot (role="group")` | Up/Down within a column, Left/Right to the neighbouring column (mirrored in RTL) at the closest rank, Home/End, Enter/Space. The active node lights up its links like a hover; the screen-reader table lists every flow. Each move is announced in a polite live region; the screen-reader table carries every value. |
| `OgeSankeyNode / OgeSankeyNodeAlign / OgeSankeyLinkColor` | `interface / string unions` | Per-node settings, the column alignments and the link colourings. |

### <OgeVectorMap>

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `geoJson` | `OgeGeoJsonFeatureCollection \| null` | `null` | Any GeoJSON `FeatureCollection`; `Polygon` and `MultiPolygon` features are drawn, fitted into the box. No tiles, no projection library. |
| `projection` | `OgeMapProjection` | `'mercator'` | `'mercator'` or `'equirectangular'`. |
| `regionKey / nameField` | `(feature) => string / string` | `undefined / 'name'` | A feature's join key (default `feature.id`, then `properties.name`) and the property holding its display name. |
| `dataSource / keyField / valueField` | `readonly T[] / string \| getter / string \| getter` | `[] / 'key' / 'value'` | The values, joined to the regions by key; regions without one read _no data_. |
| `colorScale` | `OgeChartColorScale \| undefined` | `—` | The choropleth scale (see the heatmap); default the heat tokens. |
| `showLabels` | `boolean` | `true` | Region names where the region is wide enough at the current zoom. |
| `valueFormat` | `(value: number) => string \| undefined` | `—` | The text of every value — labels, tooltip, announcements, the screen-reader table; default the locale number. |
| `legend / tooltipEnabled` | `OgeChartLegendOptions / boolean` | `{} / true` | The colour-scale legend and the region tooltip. |
| `zoomEnabled / maxZoom` | `boolean / number` | `true / 8` | Wheel (a non-passive listener), pinch, the zoom buttons and the keyboard zoom; dragging pans while zoomed (the shared chart gesture machine, Escape cancels). The view is clamped so the map never leaves the box. |
| `selectedRegions / defaultSelectedRegions` | `readonly string[]` | `undefined / []` | Selected region keys (click / Enter toggles). Controlled when `selectedRegions` is provided. |
| `animation` | `boolean \| OgeChartAnimationOptions` | `true` | The first-render draw-in and the hover / value transitions (`{ enabled, duration, easing }`); `prefers-reduced-motion` always wins. |
| `title / locale / messages` | `string / string \| undefined / Partial<OgeChartsMessages>` | `—` | Shared with every chart: the heading (also the start of the accessible name), the BCP 47 locale of every number, and per-instance message overrides — the strings of these charts live in the `visuals` block (`OgeChartsVisualMessages`). |
| `className / style` | `string / CSSProperties` | `—` | Host styling props (the docs size every chart with `style`). |

#### Methods

_OgeVectorMapHandle (ref)_

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `zoomIn() / zoomOut() / resetZoom()` | `void` | Zoom about the centre / back to the fitted view. |
| `focus()` | `void` | Moves the keyboard focus to the plot. |
| `refresh()` | `void` | Re-measures the container and re-reads the page direction (rarely needed — a ResizeObserver and a `dir` observer cover it). |
| `getSvgElement() / print(options?)` | `SVGSVGElement / Promise<void>` | The live SVG root — what the image and PDF exporters serialize (token colours are resolved to their computed values) / the browser print dialog for the chart alone. |

#### Events

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onRegionClick` | `(event: OgeChartMapRegionEvent<T>) => void` | Region click or Enter: `{ index, key, name, value, feature, source }` (not fired by the click that ends a drag). |
| `onSelectedRegionsChange` | `(selectedRegions: readonly string[]) => void` | The controlled half of `selectedRegions`. |

#### Types

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Keyboard` | `focusable plot (role="group")` | Arrows move to the nearest region in that screen direction (by centroid) and pan it into view, `+` / `-` zoom, Shift+arrows pan, `0` resets, Home/End jump, Enter/Space select. The keys are described to screen readers (`visuals.mapHint`). Each move is announced in a polite live region; the screen-reader table carries every value. |
| `OgeGeoJsonFeatureCollection / OgeGeoJsonFeature / OgeGeoJsonGeometry / OgeMapProjection` | `interfaces / string union` | The minimal GeoJSON shapes the map reads and the projections. |

### Configuration

#### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `OgeChartsConfigProvider` | `component ({ config?: OgeChartsConfigInput })` | `—` | Configures every chart below the provider — the React counterpart of `provideOgeChartsConfig()`. Shallow merge over the outer provider (or `OGE_DEFAULT_CHARTS_CONFIG`) per top-level key — a partial `messages` replaces whole nested blocks — and it re-resolves whenever `config` changes, which is how the UI language switches at runtime. |
| `useOgeChartsConfig()` | `OgeChartsConfig` | `—` | The resolved config of the current subtree. |
| `messages` | `OgeChartsMessages` | `—` | Every user-facing string, aria labels included: `aria` (`OgeChartsAriaMessages` — chart/pie labels with `{title}`/`{count}`, table caption, plot hint, legend label), `announcements` (`OgeChartsAnnouncementMessages` — live-region templates with `{series}`/`{argument}`/`{value}`), `values` (`OgeChartsValueMessages` — the words of analytic value texts: box-plot `low`/`q1`/`median`/`q3`/`high`/`outliers`, waterfall `increase`/`decrease`/`intermediate`/`total`, pareto `cumulative`, `upper`/`lower`/`signal`/`histogram`, the trendline suffix `trend` with `{value}`/`{r2}`, the histogram `bin` and the default indicator names `sma`/`ema`/`bollinger`/`macd`/`rsi`), `periods` (`OgeChartsPeriodMessages` — the range-selector period group label, button texts and their spelled-out descriptions) `visuals` (`OgeChartsVisualMessages` — the accessible names, keyboard hints, table headers, value words and announcements of the gauges, the bullet chart, the sparkline, the funnel, heatmap, treemap, sunburst, Sankey and map; count-bearing names are ICU plurals) and `noData`. Defaults: `OGE_DEFAULT_CHARTS_MESSAGES`. |
| `locale` | `string \| undefined` | `—` | BCP 47 locale for every `Intl` format in scope; a per-instance `locale` prop wins. |
| `a11yTableLimit` | `number` | `50` | Rows of the screen-reader data table. |
| `markerThreshold` | `number` | `200` | Marker circles render only up to this many points per series — beyond it the single path carries the series alone. Line-family paths additionally auto-downsample with LTTB to about one point per pixel once a series outgrows the plot width (hit-testing and tooltips keep the full data). |

## Demos

Each demo below is a complete standalone component — copy one whole and it compiles.

### Data labels

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart, OgePieChart, OgePolarChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartLabelOptions, OgeChartSeriesInput, OgePieSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

interface SalesRow {
  region: string;
  sales: number;
  target: number;
}

interface ChannelRow {
  channel: string;
  y2025: number;
  y2026: number;
}

const sales: SalesRow[] = [
  { region: 'North', sales: 182, target: 160 },
  { region: 'South', sales: 96, target: 140 },
  { region: 'East', sales: 151, target: 150 },
  { region: 'West', sales: 128, target: 130 },
  { region: 'Central', sales: 204, target: 170 },
];

const salesSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput<SalesRow>[] = [
  {
    type: 'bar',
    argumentField: 'region',
    valueField: 'sales',
    name: 'Sales',
    label: { visible: true, position: 'insideEnd' },
    customizePoint: (info) =>
      info.source !== undefined && info.source.sales < info.source.target
        ? { color: '#ef4444', description: 'below target' }
        : undefined,
  },
];

const channels: ChannelRow[] = [
  { channel: 'Online', y2025: 42, y2026: 55 },
  { channel: 'Retail', y2025: 38, y2026: 30 },
  { channel: 'Partners', y2025: 20, y2026: 15 },
];

const rings: OgePieSeriesInput<ChannelRow>[] = [
  { name: '2025', valueField: 'y2025' },
  { name: '2026', valueField: 'y2026' },
];

const percentLabels: OgeChartLabelOptions<ChannelRow> = {
  visible: true,
  position: 'inside',
  format: (info) => `${Math.round((info.percent ?? 0) * 100)}%`,
};

const goals = [
  { team: 'Design', done: 72 },
  { team: 'Web', done: 88 },
  { team: 'Mobile', done: 54 },
  { team: 'QA', done: 93 },
];

const goalSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'radialBar',
    argumentField: 'team',
    valueField: 'done',
    name: 'Done',
    label: { visible: true, format: (info) => `${info.value}%` },
  },
];

export function DataLabels() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Data labels on any series: position (outside / inside / center /
          insideEnd / insideBase), format, showForZero and overlap resolution
          (hide / shift / none). customizePoint colours single points — and its
          description is spoken in the tooltip and the screen-reader table, so
          colour is never the only channel. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={sales}
        series={salesSeries}
        title="Sales vs target (k€)"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      <div className="mt-4 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
        {/* Nested doughnut: one ring per series entry; slices of one argument
            share a colour and a legend button across rings. */}
        <OgePieChart
          dataSource={channels}
          argumentField="channel"
          type="doughnut"
          innerRadius={0.35}
          series={rings}
          label={percentLabels}
          title="Revenue by channel, 2025 → 2026"
          style={{ height: 320 }}
        />
        {/* Radial bars: one ring per category, the arc is the value. */}
        <OgePolarChart
          dataSource={goals}
          series={goalSeries}
          valueAxis={{ max: 100 }}
          title="Sprint goals done"
          style={{ height: 320 }}
        />
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```

### Trendlines & indicators

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartAxisOptions, OgeChartPane, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const panes: OgeChartPane[] = [
  { name: 'price', height: 3 },
  { name: 'rsi', height: 1 },
];

const paneAxes: OgeChartAxisOptions[] = [
  { pane: 'price', title: 'Price' },
  { pane: 'rsi', title: 'RSI', min: 0, max: 100 },
];

const prices = Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => {
  const base = 100 + Math.sin(i / 6) * 8 + i * 0.4;
  return {
    day: new Date(2026, 0, 1 + i),
    open: base - 1,
    high: base + 2.5,
    low: base - 3,
    close: base + Math.sin(i) * 1.5,
  };
});

const priceSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'ohlc',
    argumentField: 'day',
    openField: 'open',
    highField: 'high',
    lowField: 'low',
    closeField: 'close',
    name: 'OGE',
  },
  {
    type: 'indicator',
    argumentField: 'day',
    closeField: 'close',
    indicator: { type: 'bollinger', period: 20, stdDev: 2 },
  },
  {
    type: 'indicator',
    argumentField: 'day',
    closeField: 'close',
    indicator: { type: 'ema', period: 10 },
    dashStyle: 'dash',
  },
  {
    type: 'indicator',
    argumentField: 'day',
    closeField: 'close',
    indicator: { type: 'rsi', period: 14 },
    pane: 'rsi',
  },
];

const campaigns = Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({
  spend: 5 + i * 2,
  revenue: 20 + (5 + i * 2) * 3.1 + Math.sin(i * 1.7) * 9,
}));

const campaignSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'scatter',
    argumentField: 'spend',
    valueField: 'revenue',
    name: 'Campaigns',
    trendline: { type: 'linear', showR2: true },
  },
];

export function Indicators() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* Technical indicators are series: type 'indicator' computes SMA, EMA,
          Bollinger Bands, MACD or RSI from the close prices (the same pure
          ogeSma/ogeEma/ogeBollingerBands/ogeMacd/ogeRsi you can import). The
          RSI draws in its own pane under the price, sharing the argument axis. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={prices}
        series={priceSeries}
        panes={panes}
        valueAxis={paneAxes}
        zoomEnabled="wheel"
        tooltip={{ shared: true }}
        style={{ height: 440 }}
      />
      {/* Trendlines: linear, exponential, logarithmic, polynomial or moving
          average over any series; showR2 adds the fit to the tooltip. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={campaigns}
        series={campaignSeries}
        argumentAxis={{ title: 'Ad spend (k€)' }}
        valueAxis={{ title: 'Revenue (k€)' }}
        style={{ height: 300 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Waterfall & Pareto

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartAxisOptions, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const cashFlow = [
  { step: 'Opening', amount: 120 },
  { step: 'Sales', amount: 85 },
  { step: 'Services', amount: 34 },
  { step: 'Payroll', amount: -72 },
  { step: 'Rent', amount: -18 },
  { step: 'Q1', sum: 'intermediate' },
  { step: 'Tax', amount: -26 },
  { step: 'Closing', sum: 'total' },
];

const cashSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'waterfall',
    argumentField: 'step',
    valueField: 'amount',
    summaryField: 'sum',
    name: 'Cash flow',
    label: { visible: true },
  },
];

const defects = [
  { cause: 'Dents', count: 8 },
  { cause: 'Scratches', count: 46 },
  { cause: 'Wrong part', count: 12 },
  { cause: 'Misalignment', count: 31 },
  { cause: 'Other', count: 5 },
];

const defectSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'pareto',
    argumentField: 'cause',
    valueField: 'count',
    name: 'Defects',
    cumulativeAxis: 1,
  },
];

const paretoAxes: OgeChartAxisOptions[] = [
  { title: 'Count' },
  {
    position: 'end',
    title: 'Cumulative',
    max: 100,
    labelFormat: (value) => `${String(value)}%`,
  },
];

export function WaterfallPareto() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* waterfall: deltas float from the running total; summaryField marks
          'intermediate' subtotals and the 'total'. Rising, falling and sum bars
          colour by kind, dashed connectors join them, and the screen-reader
          table says "increase" / "decrease" / "total". */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={cashFlow}
        series={cashSeries}
        legend={{ visible: false }}
        title="Cash flow (k€)"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      {/* pareto: bars sort by value and a cumulative-% line runs over them on
          a second value axis. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={defects}
        series={defectSeries}
        valueAxis={paretoAxes}
        title="Defects by cause"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Box plot & histogram

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const latency = ['API', 'Web', 'Worker', 'DB'].map((service, s) => ({
  service,
  samples: Array.from(
    { length: 40 },
    (_, i) => 20 + s * 12 + ((i * 37) % 29) + (i % 13 === 0 ? 55 : 0),
  ),
}));

const latencySeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'boxPlot', argumentField: 'service', valuesField: 'samples', name: 'Latency' },
];

/** Deterministic pseudo-random 0..1 (the demo needs stable data). */
const noise = (k: number): number =>
  Math.abs(Math.sin(k * 12.9898) * 43758.5453) % 1;

const heights = Array.from({ length: 240 }, (_, i) => ({
  height: 150 + 20 * (noise(i) + noise(i + 1000) + noise(i + 2000)),
}));

const heightSeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  {
    type: 'histogram',
    valueField: 'height',
    name: 'People',
    bins: { width: 5 },
    label: { visible: true },
  },
];

export function Distributions() {
  return (
    <>
      {/* boxPlot from raw samples: quartiles, Tukey whiskers (1.5 × IQR) and
          outlier dots — or from precomputed q1/median/q3 fields. The tooltip
          and the screen-reader table read Min, Q1, Median, Q3, Max. */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={latency}
        series={latencySeries}
        valueAxis={{ title: 'ms' }}
        title="Response time by service"
        style={{ height: 320 }}
      />
      {/* histogram: bins the values (count, width or explicit thresholds);
          bars span their bins and the argument reads "165 – 170". */}
      <OgeChart
        dataSource={heights}
        series={heightSeries}
        argumentAxis={{ title: 'Height (cm)' }}
        title="Height distribution"
        style={{ height: 300 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Export & print

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef } from 'react';
import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartHandle, OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const energy = [
  { month: 'Jan', solar: 12, wind: 30, hydro: 18 },
  { month: 'Feb', solar: 16, wind: 27, hydro: 17 },
  { month: 'Mar', solar: 24, wind: 25, hydro: 20 },
  { month: 'Apr', solar: 31, wind: 22, hydro: 22 },
  { month: 'May', solar: 38, wind: 18, hydro: 24 },
  { month: 'Jun', solar: 42, wind: 16, hydro: 21 },
];

const energySeries: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'stackedSplineArea', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'solar', name: 'Solar' },
  { type: 'stackedSplineArea', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'wind', name: 'Wind' },
  { type: 'stackedSplineArea', argumentField: 'month', valueField: 'hydro', name: 'Hydro' },
];

export function EnergyExport() {
  const chart = useRef<OgeChartHandle>(null);

  const exportPng = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToPng } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image');
    if (chart.current) await exportChartToPng(chart.current, { filename: 'energy.png' });
  };
  const exportJpeg = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToJpeg } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-image');
    if (chart.current) {
      await exportChartToJpeg(chart.current, { filename: 'energy.jpeg', quality: 0.9 });
    }
  };
  // Non-WinAnsi titles (Turkish ğ ş ı İ, Greek, Cyrillic) need a Unicode font:
  // pass `font`, or register one once with setOgePdfDefaultFont() from
  // @oge-ui/behavior — every OGE PDF export then uses it.
  const exportPdf = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const { exportChartToPdf } = await import('@oge-ui/react-charts/export-pdf');
    if (chart.current) {
      await exportChartToPdf(chart.current, {
        filename: 'energy.pdf',
        title: 'Energy mix',
        subtitle: 'Generation by source, GWh',
      });
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
      {/* Export without a chart library: PNG/JPEG rasterize the live SVG
          (styles inlined), PDF embeds that image under a real-text title in a
          jsPDF page (an optional peer, loaded only by /export-pdf), and print()
          opens the browser dialog for the chart alone. */}
      <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportPng()}>PNG</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportJpeg()}>JPEG</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void exportPdf()}>PDF</button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => void chart.current?.print()}>Print</button>
      </div>
      <OgeChart
        ref={chart}
        dataSource={energy}
        series={energySeries}
        title="Energy mix (GWh)"
        style={{ height: 340 }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```

### Rotated bars

```ts
'use client';

import { OgeChart } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';
import type { OgeChartSeriesInput } from '@oge-ui/react-charts';

const data = [
  { region: 'North', online: 420, retail: 310 },
  { region: 'East', online: 380, retail: 260 },
  { region: 'South', online: 290, retail: 340 },
  { region: 'West', online: 510, retail: 220 },
  { region: 'Central', online: 240, retail: 180 },
];

const series: OgeChartSeriesInput[] = [
  { type: 'stackedBar', valueField: 'online', name: 'Online' },
  { type: 'stackedBar', valueField: 'retail', name: 'Retail' },
];

export function RotatedBars() {
  return (
    // rotated swaps the axes: the argument axis runs down the left, values
    // grow to the right. Every series type follows — these stackedBar series
    // become horizontal stacked bars — and so do the tooltip, crosshair, zoom
    // and the keyboard (Up/Down walk the categories, Left/Right the series).
    <OgeChart
      dataSource={data}
      series={series}
      commonSeries={{ argumentField: 'region' }}
      rotated
      tooltip={{ shared: true }}
      valueAxis={{ title: 'Units sold', abbreviate: false }}

    />
  );
```
